sn35.246:1.1: yassa kassaci bhikkhave bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu uppajjeyya chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vāpi cetaso tato cittaṃ nivāreyya
sn35.246:1.2: sabhayo ceso maggo sappaṭibhayo sakaṇṭako ca sagahano ca ummaggo ca kumaggo ca duhitiko ca
sn35.246:1.3: asappurisasevito ceso maggo na ceso maggo sappurisasevito
sn35.246:1.6: yassa kassaci bhikkhave bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā jivhāviññeyyesu rasesu …pe…
sn35.246:1.7: manoviññeyyesu dhammesu uppajjeyya chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā sappaṭighaṃ vāpi cetaso tato cittaṃ nivāreyya
sn35.246:1.8: sabhayo ceso maggo sappaṭibhayo ca sakaṇṭako ca sagahano ca ummaggo ca kumaggo ca duhitiko ca
sn35.246:1.9: asappurisasevito ceso maggo na ceso maggo sappurisasevito
sn35.246:2.2: kiṭṭhārakkho ca pamatto goṇo ca kiṭṭhādo aduṃ kiṭṭhaṃ otaritvā yāvadatthaṃ madaṃ āpajjeyya pamādaṃ āpajjeyya.
sn35.246:2.3: evameva kho bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano chasu phassāyatanesu asaṃvutakārī pañcasu kāmaguṇesu yāvadatthaṃ madaṃ āpajjati pamādaṃ āpajjati.
sn35.246:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave kiṭṭhaṃ sampannaṃ kiṭṭhārakkho ca appamatto goṇo ca kiṭṭhādo aduṃ kiṭṭhaṃ otareyya
sn35.246:3.3: nāsāya suggahitaṃ gahetvā uparighaṭāyaṃ suniggahitaṃ niggaṇheyya
sn35.246:3.4: uparighaṭāyaṃ suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā daṇḍena sutāḷitaṃ tāḷeyya
sn35.246:3.7: tatiyampi kho bhikkhave goṇo kiṭṭhādo aduṃ kiṭṭhaṃ otareyya
sn35.246:3.9: nāsāya suggahitaṃ gahetvā uparighaṭāyaṃ suniggahitaṃ niggaṇheyya
sn35.246:3.10: uparighaṭāyaṃ suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā daṇḍena sutāḷitaṃ tāḷeyya
sn35.246:3.12: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave goṇo kiṭṭhādo gāmagato vā araññagato vā ṭhānabahulo vā assa nisajjabahulo vā na taṃ kiṭṭhaṃ puna otareyya
sn35.246:3.14: evameva kho bhikkhave yato bhikkhuno chasu phassāyatanesu cittaṃ udujjitaṃ hoti sudujjitaṃ ajjhattameva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati.
sn35.246:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rañño vā rājamahāmattassa vā vīṇāya saddo assutapubbo assa.
sn35.246:4.4: ambho kassa nu kho eso saddo evaṃrajaniyo evaṃkammaniyo evaṃmadaniyo evaṃmucchaniyo evaṃbandhaniyoti.
sn35.246:4.6: esā kho bhante vīṇā nāma yassā eso saddo evaṃrajaniyo evaṃkammaniyo evaṃmadaniyo evaṃmucchaniyo evaṃbandhaniyoti.
sn35.246:4.8: gacchatha me bho taṃ vīṇaṃ āharathāti.
sn35.246:4.11: ayaṃ kho sā bhante vīṇā yassā eso saddo evaṃrajaniyo evaṃkammaniyo evaṃmadaniyo evaṃmucchaniyo evaṃbandhaniyoti.
sn35.246:4.13: alaṃ me bho tāya vīṇāya tameva me saddaṃ āharathāti.
sn35.246:4.15: ayaṃ kho bhante vīṇā nāma anekasambhārā mahāsambhārā
sn35.246:4.17: doṇiñca paṭicca mañcaṃ paṭicca daṇḍañca paṭicca upadhāraṇe ca paṭicca tantiyo ca paṭicca koṇañca paṭicca purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca evāyaṃ bhante vīṇā nāma anekasambhārā mahāsambhārā
sn35.246:4.19: so taṃ vīṇaṃ dasadhā vā satadhā vā phāleyya dasadhā vā satadhā vā taṃ phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya
sn35.246:4.20: sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā agginā ḍaheyya agginā ḍahitvā masiṃ kareyya
sn35.246:4.21: masiṃ karitvā mahāvātena vā ophuneyya nadiyā vā sīghasotāya pavāheyya.
sn35.246:4.23: asati kirāyaṃ bho vīṇā nāma yathevaṃ yaṅkiñci vīṇā nāma etthapanāyaṃ jano ativelampatto palāḷitoti.
sn35.246:4.24: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu rūpaṃ samannesati yāvatā rūpassa gati vedanaṃ samannesati yāvatā vedanāya gati saññaṃ samannesati yāvatā saññāya gati saṅkhāre samannesati yāvatā saṅkhārānaṃ gati viññāṇaṃ samannesati yāvatā viññāṇassa gati.
sn35.246:4.25: tassa rūpaṃ samannesato yāvatā rūpassa gati vedanaṃ samannesato …pe…
sn35.246:4.29: yampissa taṃ hoti ahanti vā mamanti vā asmīti vā tampi tassa na hotīti.
